title: sdks: unify auth/retries, improve streaming ergonomics, parity fixes & bump v1.146.0
author: Priya Nair
description: Motivation: Bring Python/TypeScript/Go SDKs to parity for auth/retries behavior and streaming ergonomics, fix a couple of runtime-facing interoperability bugs, and bump package versions to v1.146.0. This PR consolidates shared retry logic, standardizes token refresh and auth header behavior, improves client streaming backpressure handling across SDKs (preventing stalled streams observed in prod), and includes small ergonomics tweaks to TypeScript/Go streaming interfaces so canonical patterns match Python. Changes are backwards-compatible for normal sync APIs; streaming consumers should see improved stability (and may benefit from a simpler cancellation API).
commits: refactor(sdk): extract common auth middleware and token refresh utilities
feat(sdk): unified retry policy + configurable backoff across sdks
fix(streaming): TS/Go streaming backpressure and cancelation race fixes
chore(release): bump python/typescript/go sdk versions to v1.146.0
docs: add migration notes for streaming ergonomics and retry tuning
files_changed: sdks/python/redwood_sdk/auth.py — extracted TokenManager and middleware hookup
sdks/python/redwood_sdk/retries.py — unified RetryPolicy, default backoff params
sdks/python/redwood_sdk/streaming.py — improved iterator cancellation handling, added tests
sdks/typescript/src/auth.ts — mirrored TokenManager + refresh hooks, updated typings
sdks/typescript/src/streaming.ts — backpressure queue + abort controller ergonomic API
sdks/go/redwood/retries.go — retry policy parity with python/ts
docs/sdk/migration/1.146.0.md — migration notes and recommended config

merge_commit_message:
sdks: unify auth/retries, streaming ergonomics & bump v1.146.0

Consolidates TokenManager and RetryPolicy across Python/TS/Go, fixes streaming backpressure/cancellation races, updates examples and docs, bumps SDK versions to v1.146.0
release_notes:
- SDKs (Python/TypeScript/Go) bumped to v1.146.0
- Unified auth TokenManager with safer token refresh path for concurrent requests
- Unified RetryPolicy and default backoff parameters across SDKs
- Streaming ergonomics: cancelable streams simplified (AbortController/context cancellation) and backpressure improved
- Bug fixes: TS/Go streaming race leading to stalled streams fixed
- Migration notes added in docs/sdk/migration/1.146.0.md
notes_for_backports: Small auth middleware refactor; consider backporting token refresh concurrency fixes to 1.145.x for high-volume customers experiencing token-thundering
manual_upgrade_steps: 1) Update SDK packages to v1.146.0. 2) For streaming clients: replace current cancelation pattern with AbortController (TS) or context cancellation (Go) or use new cancelable iterator helper in Python. 3) Validate retry settings if you relied on custom backoff; default params changed to improve stability under transient errors.
regressions_tested: unit tests across SDKs, streaming integration tests in perf-canary, manual end-to-end example for cancelation and token refresh under load
notes: This PR was intentionally scoped to SDK surface and examples only. Runtime/server changes were not required. We coordinated with releases team to ensure the package publish pipeline had a dry-run and all artifacts were verified before the final publish step.
